It's a country that has been declining 20% this year.

kpis.nom_fr: Part des chirurgiens americains utilisant la robotique
kpis.nom_source: surgeons that use robotics in the U.S.
kpis.citation: Percentage of surgeons that use robotics in the U.S. Remains 20%. 80% of surgeons don't use a robot in the U.S. When you look at all U.S. dynamics, 10% of surgeons will use a robot, 90% do not.

We recently acquired, three quarters now, four quarters ago, OrthoGrid for direct anterior and similar technologies outside of the U.S. Ivan Tornos Chairman, President, and CEO at Zimmer Biomet: When you look at the percentage of surgeons that use robots, again, they're 20% in the U.S., 29,000 orthopedic surgeons, 20% use robots here in the U.S. One robot does not fit all.

kpis.nom_fr: Part des medecins pratiquant l arthroplastie de l epaule
kpis.citation: Today, only about 20% of doctors perform shoulder arthroplasties because it is a very difficult procedure.

kpis.nom_fr: Part des arthroplasties inversees de l epaule
kpis.citation: Reverse is roughly 70% of all shoulder arthroplasties around the world, especially here in the U.S. You got a third of surgeons that prefer an anatomic approach, and again, we are the only company that offers both.

kpis.nom_fr: Fourchette de pression sur les prix

kpis.citation: It is very much within the guidance that we provided of flat to 100 basis points.

kpis.nom_fr: Part de l implant dans le cout total
kpis.citation: As you know, most of these ASCs are owned by surgeons or private equity companies or astute operators that understand that the implant is only around 14%-15% of the overall cost.

kpis.nom_fr: Part du chiffre d affaires sous contrat
kpis.citation: With all that rambling, I'll tell you, we don't expect the second half to be an uptick when it comes to price erosion. 85% of our book of business is contracted.
Up to $2 billion acquisition price, ideally.
We're looking for a double-digit return on investment capital, or invested capital ROIC, by the year five.
I want to thank again all the employees, 17,000 of you at Zimmer Biomet who do so much every day.
